topic: What time does the last Tube leave Brixton on a Saturday night?

text: ok who has the tickets. did rory send them or do we each have to pick up
I have them 🙌 transferred to all of you, check your apps
Got it
Got mine ty rory

Doors 7, support on at 8 I think. Headliner gets on about 10
dont be late for the support this time freya
I was ONE time and it was the tube's fault
It was not the tube's fault
meeting point?? outside the tube or inside by the bar
Outside kentish town tube 6.45 so we get in the queue. There's always a queue
6.45 is early ok fine
Im on till 5 so I'll be there 6.45 if the bus isnt being a dick. Might just tube it
We leave from the flat together then
You're on lates aren't you. I'll get the bus
I'm on lates on fri not sat. Sat I'm off 🙃

I'll get the northern line from clapham north, dont ask me which branch

Night tube does victoria on fri and sat yeah. Not sure about the last one from brixton though
There's a night tube on sat but not every line, I think the victoria one runs all night
"i think" is doing a lot of work there ben
I'm 70% sure
ok i'll check tfl later. if it's not all night i'm not walking from brixton at 3am
Nobody's making you walk
should we just get a taxi back together? split it 4 ways. drop me first then you lot to peckham and clapham

Kentish town to brixton is like 25 quid at that time. 4 ways is about 6 each
honestly yes
YES please. My feet are going to be done
6 each is fine. I'll go halves on the bus money thing if it's not worth it
Ben you are not getting the bus home at 2am 😭
I didn't say I was
I'll put the taxi on the group thing when we're in it. Let's say 2am out front of the forum
can someone please check the venue actually has a taxi rank out front, last time it was a nightmare
It's on the main road? There's always black cabs. Stop stressing
i'm not stressing
She's stressing
[photo: my new colour, it's called "mushroom latte" and I am OBSESSED ]
that's gorgeous you're going to be the best looking one there
It's a gig freya nobody's looking at your hair
Rory I will remember this
Just checked, bags are fine at the forum, no big bags
ok good i'm bringing my small bag and that's it
I'll be in my work boots if anyone wants to have a go at me about that
We know ben
